refinement.vendor_agnostic_engine: OPERATOR FRAMING 2026-07-22 (authoritative): Handshake is a model/vendor-agnostic engine that WRAPS whatever runs the model. The CLI/terminal transport exists only because Anthropic subscription plans block economical direct API use - it is a lane, not the architecture. The wrapper owns: sandboxing, tool-call gating/stopping (SC MT-011), hooks (SC MT-012), cron/scheduling (SC MT-013), and exposing Handshake API/primitives as governed tools (SC MT-014). Claude and GPT are the first two engines; open-source/other vendors follow. Vendor harness behaviors in the research basis were input, not target; per-lane specifics live only in adapters and classification-table data; no vendor names in schemas, policy vocabulary, or operator-facing surfaces. A future direct-API lane replaces a CLI lane without touching wrapper capabilities. Implementing sessions must treat any vendor-coupled shortcut outside a lane adapter as a defect.

scope_edges.in_scope: Pillar A: long-lived steerable agent sessions (Thread/Turn/Item + steer/interrupt) replacing the null-stdin one-shot CLI contract; Claude stream-json bidirectional transport; Codex app-server JSON-RPC transport (turn/steer first-class); ACP client layer (official Rust crate) incl. repo-gov duty parity proof vs .GOV/tools/handshake-acp-bridge; Handshake Roles (schema/registry/injection/importer/GUI); governed model-to-model spawn+steer tools (SwarmCoordinator sole spawn path, deny-by-default policy, injection-scan, parent-child registry); MT dispatch lifecycle (hsk.mt_signal@1 structured exits, zero-polling notification, validation handoff); worktree merge-back (merge engine, conflict bridge to native merge UI, patch fallback, governance gates, reclaim); FR/ledger/transcript/audit recording + manuals. Pillar B: annotation core (hsk.annotation@1, Gerrit-style provenance, Hypothesis-style multi-selector anchors, fuzzy re-anchor, explicit ORPHANED), notes annotation UI (markers, panel, authoring, live model annotations, quarantine), native block-level prose diff + 3-way merge UI (closes the diff_engine.rs DEFERRED item, ports document_diff_merge.ts), gated removal of the legacy TS/React notes editor, IDE parity matrix + 9 confirmed gap MTs (peek view, breadcrumbs, snippets, SCM gutter, inline blame, inline-AI-edit seam, agent context-attach seam, on-save actions, timeline/local history).
scope_edges.out_of_scope: Studio/Stage annotation rollout (seam only); repo-governance process changes and the actual ACP-duty cutover decision; new model engines/provider lanes beyond WP-1; Flight Recorder schema changes (additive kinds only); non-notes TS surfaces; features owned by WP-KERNEL-011 shell (command palette, split-dock, quick-open, terminal, zen-mode), WP-KERNEL-012 (in-flight editor MTs), 013/014 stubs, WP-KERNEL-STUDIO (whiteboard/canvas).

assumptions: WP-1-Multi-Model-Orchestration, WP-CKC-posekit, and WP-KERNEL-012 are validated and merged BEFORE activation; all 101 MT contracts were grounded against those worktrees as of 2026-07-21/22 and a post-merge grounding re-check is an activation step.
The sandbox AttachedStdioContract currently hard-rejects piped stdin (sandbox/adapter.rs validate); SC MT-004 is the load-bearing unblocker for all steering transports.
internal_diagnostics and Palmistry (WP-KERNEL-015) may not exist when WP-017 runs; all such wiring is typed DEFERRED, never silently skipped.

Claude stream-json contract is under-documented upstream and version-sensitive (queued-steer since v2.1.205; interrupt via reverse-engineered control_request): capability feature-detection + pinned version ranges + CI contract tests are mandatory, and only the interrupt subtype of the undocumented control protocol is used.
ACP has no mid-turn steer primitive (sequential turns): ACP is the cross-agent abstraction, native stream-json/app-server adapters carry first-class steering.
non_goals: No model-initiated spawn path outside SwarmCoordinator; no auto-conflict-resolution or force-push in merge-back; no full --system-prompt replacement for roles; no polling anywhere in the MT lifecycle loop; no annotation without provenance for model authors; no TS-editor removal before the machine-checked parity gate is GREEN.

findings: Model-initiated spawn/steer is a privilege-escalation surface: mitigated by SwarmCoordinator-only spawn path, deny-by-default policy (MM MT-106), caps/leases, full ledger attribution, injection-scan (MM MT-104) on all inter-model content.
Upstream CLI contract drift (stream-json/app-server): mitigated by capability feature-detection, pinned version ranges, CI contract suites (CS MT-028, CX MT-047, AP MT-066), unknown-event tolerance.
Premature TS-editor removal: mitigated by machine-checked gate (TR MT-261) reading WP-012 evidence + PD MT-245 parity suite + operator sign-off row; gate RED today.
Annotation mis-attachment after edits: mitigated by multi-selector anchors, bounded fuzzy re-anchor, explicit ORPHANED/OUTDATED states, adversarial drift suite (AC MT-209).

Merge-back destroying work: mitigated by no-force invariant (grep-provable), no auto-conflict-resolution, protected-branch operator approval, abort-always-available, runtime negative proofs (WM MT-148).
